title: Wappalyzer Technology Detection
description: Detected technologies used by the target web application.
risk_reason: 技术识别信息，未直接表明存在可利用漏洞

title: Exposed Administration Panel
description: An administration login interface is accessible from the scanned network.
remediation: Restrict administrative interfaces to trusted networks.
risk_reason: 管理接口暴露会增加攻击面

title: Possible Sensitive File Exposure
description: Scanner reported a potentially sensitive file.
evidence: HTTP response was returned, but response content was not sufficient to confirm that sensitive information was actually exposed.
risk_reason: 扫描器发现疑似敏感文件，但证据不足

title: Server Version Information
description: The web server disclosed its product name and version.
evidence: Server header contained product and version information.
risk_reason: 属于信息泄露类资产指纹，不代表已经存在可利用漏洞

title: Known Vulnerable Component Detected
description: The detected component version matches a known vulnerable version according to the scanner rule.
evidence: Product and version fingerprint matched the vulnerability detection rule.
remediation: Verify the component version and apply the vendor security update.
risk_reason: 组件版本与已知漏洞检测规则匹配，需要优先处置

title: Generic Error Page Detection
description: Scanner matched a generic error page pattern.
evidence: The response contained a common error-related keyword but no sensitive information.
risk_reason: 匹配证据较弱，可能只是普通错误页面

title: Potential Backup File Exposure
description: A possible backup file location responded to the scanner.
evidence: The server returned a successful response, but the response body was not verified as a real backup file.
remediation: Verify whether the resource contains sensitive backup data.
risk_reason: 存在疑似备份文件响应，但证据不足以确认泄露

title: Accessible Debug Endpoint
description: A debug interface was confirmed accessible and returned application diagnostic information.
evidence: The endpoint returned debugging and runtime diagnostic information.
remediation: Disable the debug interface in production or restrict access.
risk_reason: 调试接口已确认暴露并返回诊断信息
